scope: graph and MultiTransport performance for shm_seqlock

environment.method: RealTimeApp graph trigger -> publisher -> shm_seqlock -> importer/listener -> sinks; message rate paced by a sender thread; final stats are post-warmup.

limits: Publisher and listeners run in one process (loopback graph); cross-process graph not measured.
raw mode uses ShmSeqlockImporterExporter; multi uses MultiTransport publisher/listener with shm_seqlock channels.
payload 256 bytes; layouts inline, read classic; wait spin/futex; 1 or 4 sinks.
Rate=0 is saturation; sinks may lose messages there, which is reported separately.
Percentiles are per-round histogram quantiles averaged over rounds (<=1.6% bucket error).
The host is shared; affinity is not pinned for this run.
note: 12 configs x 5 rounds, all PASS. 10k msg/s configs have zero loss; rate=0 saturation with 4 listeners loses on the shared per-segment reader thread by design.
